scope: post-locked-test diagnostic replay only; videos never enter primary statistics or checkpoint selection

categories.typical_success: Among successes, minimize absolute distance from the method-height successful-episode median margin, then median pitch-rate RMS, then training seed and scenario ID.
categories.typical_failure: If failures exist, apply the same deterministic median-distance rule within failures; missing margin sorts after valid margin.
categories.worst_margin: Minimum valid episode minimum margin, then highest pitch-rate RMS, training seed, and scenario ID; if no valid margin exists, select the deterministic first missing-margin episode and disclose it.
categories.highest_pitch_rate: Maximum episode support-transfer pitch-rate RMS, then lowest margin, training seed, and scenario ID.

deduplication: If one episode satisfies multiple categories for a method/height, encode it once and list every category in the overlay/inventory.
seed_policy: B/C candidates include all locked episodes from seeds 11/29/47. Deterministic seed tie-break is ascending; video choice does not alter all-seed statistics.
failure_policy: Do not require a failure video when no failure exists. Never omit a failure category when at least one failed locked episode exists.
replay_policy: Replay the exact locked scenario with the frozen controller/checkpoint and required locked-manifest hash. Compare replay outcome with the recorded locked outcome and disclose any mismatch.
